name: tailrocks-repository-skills
description: Target-bound repository orchestration plus pull-request planning, consolidation, creation, refresh, review, documentation, templates, guarded merge, audit, and cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Target-aware repository coordination, audit, and cleanup.
interface.longDescription: tailrocks-repository-merge coordinates selected sources into one exact destination through audit, plan, consolidate, and lifecycle phases, while the bundled pull-request skills plan, consolidate, create, refresh, review, document, template, and guard landing eligibility; audit, plan, consolidate, and cleanup remain independently callable.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate these sources into the exact selected repository target.
Plan these audited sources into ordered pull-request groups, or consolidate the selected groups into candidate branches.
Review, create, refresh, document, template, or land this pull request through its guarded owner.
Audit these repository sources against the selected target.
Clean up these resolved sources only after their evidence is verified.
